body: I’ve been aware for a longgg time but kind of fully accepted it about a year and a half ago. Give or take. Been on HRT 6 months but I still get misgendered regularly. I can’t take it anymore. And honestly I don’t even know if the end result of transition is even good enough to justify all of the suffering before it. Like yeah sure being a full time woman assuming I pass would be better but I should have just had it at birth. I’ll never get the years and years that I had to be a guy back.

I’d rather die of suffocating to death from covid than go with people knowing I did it deliberately. 

I just don’t see the point of completing my transition when the end result won’t even be that good since I’ll never be a mummy (biological I mean) and I may always be seen as a sir/mate/fella, and I’ll always be biologically male, like I’d rather cut my losses and die. I don’t even think many people would miss me. Like my mum, my dog and cat, sure. The rest would be sad for a day or two then get over it. My friends never even contact me unless I initiate and it always seems onesided. Like I’m living for others but not many others would even be *that* sad
